scope: one-step mixed-context completion of artificially hidden observed target pixels
split_unit: source image identity; one target per image
normalization: reuse frozen pilot development scales and method; no replication tuning
limitations: Original SAM support is a visible-mask proxy, not verified full amodal ground truth.
Selection and generation never receive hidden RGB or the held-out support mask.
Crop construction uses pre-occlusion visible support, and is identical for all methods.
This isolates one-step candidate selection; it does not establish end-to-end progressive gains.
No trained surface model or independent human preference result is assumed.
